segments.name: aprevo
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and markets the aprevo technology platform for personalized spine fusion surgical procedures for hospitals and ambulatory surgical centers.
segments.evidence: The Company has one business activity and operates as a single operating and reportable segment: the designing, manufacturing, and marketing of aprevo, a comprehensive technology platform for spine fusion surgical procedures.
